browserResults.sessionScopeNote: Includes nine browser scopes, workbench performance, two separate editor-budget sessions and Studio large-file performance.

baseline.interpretation: Reviewed completed editor/workbench captures are comparative inputs; this does not change the a5 overall failure or waive a6 thresholds.

largeFile.measurement: input/keydown/scroll event to two requestAnimationFrame callbacks

editor.methodology: Real headless browser; event-to-two-RAF upper bound, including frame scheduling; no OS input-to-display or native claim.
editor.cause: Not established by this capture; there is no scheduler or GC trace.

environment.browserProcess: shared; fresh isolated context per round

workbench.scopeNote: The workbench capture and both comparisons completed and passed before the enclosing performance scope reported the editor failure.

model.methodology: One cold sample, explicit warmups, then nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 over retained raw samples. Model timings exclude browser events and paint.

memory.methodology: Measured signed GC-retained heap/ArrayBuffer deltas. Sources are ASCII. Undo attribution clears history while preserving current text.

definition.workspaceProof: Raw capture retains exact four workspace records, three source documents and project ownership plus observed definition boundary DOM state.

overview.measurement: Actual OverviewRuler render plus pixel readback; renderMs and followingRafMs remain separate raw fields.

studio-large-file.input: synthetic File/Blob assigned through DataTransfer to the real Studio file-input change handler
limits: No OS file chooser or native file permission claim
Functional case; latency budgets belong to the existing editor benchmark

environment.contexts: fresh isolated context per capture; browser process shared; serial alternating order

assessment.gate: ratio of paired sums of the identical measured workload; strictly less than 1%
assessment.interpretation: One bounded shared-host observation; not statistical proof. All raw samples retained.

environment.processes: 24 fresh browser processes/profiles, serial, 12 alternating pairs; no warm-ups or retries

assessment.gate: paired aggregate eager ScriptDuration is strictly greater than lazy ScriptDuration
assessment.uncertainty: Untrimmed single shared-host observation; positive aggregate is not statistical proof. CDP/OS clock quantization is unknown; no zero/noise observations are discarded. No historical, worker CPU, paint, or wall-startup speedup claim.

audit.editorRawStatistics: Independent text/model owner recomputed all 500 samples, counts, p50/p95/p99/min/max and comparative deltas exactly.
audit.workbenchRawStatistics: Independent text/model owner recomputed 126 samples and all group counts/percentiles; baseline environment and fixture match.
audit.sourceCausality: No causal attribution, noise explanation or accepted performance waiver is inferred from the observed tails.
audit.executions: No tests, build, browser capture, benchmark, scanner or qualification was run while preparing this archive.
audit.priorAttempts: Existing a1-a5 archives, failures, documents and publication maps are unchanged.

archive.integrity: Every extracted member matches its ZIP member byte-for-byte. The ZIP digest matches the supplied identity, upload log and API metadata; the job-log digest matches its supplied identity. API snapshot bytes are retained exactly as provided; they are decoded tool-response JSON, not claimed raw HTTP wire bytes.

limits: Overall a6 qualification failed; evidence does not close Project16 or accept a performance exception.
This attempt covers the recorded Linux/Ubuntu Chromium environment only, not other operating systems or browser engines.
Headless event-to-two-RAF timing includes scheduling and is not physical input-to-display latency, refresh-rate certification or Safari qualification.
Nine A20 skips remain skips, including unsupported native Vim capabilities and the unavailable pinned Unicode 16.0 host comparison.
Actual browser IME, screen-reader, native desktop/Visual Studio oracle, OS clipboard grants and physical file chooser/disk throughput are not certified by these fixtures.
Instrumentation and lazy-evaluation results are bounded aggregate observations; per-operation increases and negative pairs are retained, without a general speedup or statistical-proof claim.
Model timings and GC-retained Node memory do not measure browser paint, total allocations or browser DOM memory.
